mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over the past month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer credit (RSAFS) is rising and industrial production (INDPRO) is falling, it indicates a credit-fueled consumption boom in a weakening supply environment, signaling an impending economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS rises and INDPRO falls, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), a rise in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) reflects improving consumer confidence and economic activity, boosting corporate earnings expectations and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) is rising and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising, it signals a tight labor market combined with monetary tightening, increasing corporate costs and reducing profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market tightness with monetary tightening
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 > 19000), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a cooling in the real estate sector, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines and GDPC1 > 19000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
